# Memory and Resource

This example separates WIPI memory IDs from resolved data pointers and tests a small packaged resource. It demonstrates `MC_knlAlloc`, `MC_knlCalloc`, `MC_GETDPTR`, `MC_knlFree`, memory statistics, resource lookup, and resource copying.
